final: SELECT AVG(g.a) AS result FROM (SELECT e.ordersmark, o.orderflow, AVG(e.fillcount) AS a FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark WHERE CAST(e.expirespot AS TEXT) > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND CAST(e.expirespot AS TEXT) < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY e.ordersmark, o.orderflow) g
